brain.commentary: The cross-asset regime is risk_on, but conviction is only marginally above neutral and composites are weak. Maintain a restrained risk budget. BTC is the strongest and most liquid signal, while ETH and especially SOL carry higher volatility, adverse alpha, and/or weaker liquidity. LTC is fragile and should be de-emphasized. XRP, DOGE, ADA, AVAX, LINK, BCH, UNI, XLM, and ETC are also fragile because their identical long signals have zero volatility, expected-shortfall, alpha, institutional, and liquidity inputs, indicating insufficient risk diagnostics rather than robust conviction.
